Ready to Race?
Welcome to the Sports-Class Racing Series, a series of international high-level competitions to crown a Sports-Class Champion at the end of 2027. If you enjoy racing mid-aspect wings, you’ve come to the right place!

The SRS is for pilots who have outgrown fun and national competitions and are looking to take the next step.

Expand page for more details
 Flying site

The Lijak Paragliding Take-off is one of Slovenia’s best-known paragliding launch sites, located above the Nova Gorica area in western Slovenia. It offers spectacular views of the Vipava Valley and the Adriatic region.
